change_password.description: You'll use this password to log into your Hobbier account. Create one with at least 6 letters and numbers.
change_password.tips_link: How to create a strong password
change_password.security_note: If someone else used your account, we recommend changing your password periodically and not sharing it.

We will send a recovery link to:
{email}
change_password.reset_sent: We sent the link to your email address.
change_password.reset_error: Could not send the recovery email.
change_password.min_length: The new password must be at least 6 characters long.
change_password.letters_and_numbers: The new password must contain at least one letter and one number.
change_password.different_from_current: The new password cannot be the same as your current password.
change_password.passwords_dont_match: The new passwords do not match.
change_password.tips_subtitle: Recommendations to protect your Hobbier account:
change_password.tip_1: Use at least 6 characters (8 or more recommended).
change_password.tip_2: Combine uppercase letters, lowercase letters, and numbers.
change_password.tip_3: Avoid common words or numeric sequences (e.g. 123456).
change_password.tip_4: Do not use easy-to-guess personal info, such as your birthday.
